identity.core_motion: motion is contract-bound, debt-accruing, hierarchically gated, spiritually persistent, and paid for after it appears to end
identity.visual_language: black marble, white-gold ledgers, church spires, wax seals, ghost chains, coin halos, contract ribbons, masked nobility, thrull labor, and pale spirit afterimages
identity.tone: elegant, oppressive, sacred-but-transactional, patient, aristocratic, legalistic, ghostly, quietly predatory
avoid: generic white-black morality language without debt or hierarchy
mono-white public justice without profit motive
mono-black raw ambition without institutional ritual
Azorius neutral law/civic bureaucracy without money, guilt, or afterlife obligation
Rakdos spectacle or Dimir spy language as primary metaphor

animation_layers.purpose: establish the Orzhov result as a signed obligation rather than a simple answer
animation_layers.motion: a black-white contract ribbon unfurls behind the card or panel, then folds into a wax-sealed underline

animation_layers.purpose: represent extort, taxation, and payment triggers
animation_layers.motion: small white-gold coins pulse from opposing nodes toward the Orzhov seal whenever an action resolves

animation_layers.purpose: represent haunt, afterlife, death triggers, and persistent obligation
animation_layers.motion: a pale spirit silhouette rises from a fading creature/card and remains briefly as a second outline

animation_layers.purpose: represent life gain/drain, debt compounding, recursion, and aristocrat engines
animation_layers.motion: thin ledger lines stack beside the result, each line converting a black loss mark into a white life mark

animation_layers.purpose: represent controlled access, rank, compliance, and prison/pillowfort effects
animation_layers.motion: arched gates close halfway around the panel; approved elements pass through as others dim or tap downward
a wax seal stamps once, leaving a faint black-gold emblem and a ghostly echo ring

Detain.microcopy: Bound by clause, not by force.

ConstraintField.microcopy: Every action passes through the fee schedule.
